candidate_text: When revising earlier work for me, preserve the portions that remain correct and isolate the defective part for correction.

candidate_text: For recommendations, the user prefers confidence calibrated to the evidence and a clear account of what the available evidence cannot establish.
draft_notes: Recommendation preference covers confidence and evidence limits

candidate_text: The user expects technical claims drawn from external material to remain traceable to their original source.
draft_notes: Source-use preference preserves claim-level traceability

candidate_text: Before broad automated edits, show the user a reversible preview of the resulting state so they can inspect what the automation would change.
draft_notes: Reusable preview rule centers inspection of resulting state

candidate_text: Execution instructions for the user should identify prerequisites, the context in which each command runs, and the operational outcome to expect before execution begins.
draft_notes: Execution-context preference exposes readiness and expected outcome

candidate_text: Project handoffs include unresolved risks and identify who owns each follow-up after the transfer.
draft_notes: Cross-project handoff rule retains risks and follow-up ownership

draft_notes: Adopted rollout rule defines observable reversal triggers

candidate_text: Whenever an interaction reveals information only within a timed interval, provide an equivalent way to obtain that information without matching the timing.
draft_notes: Timing-dependent interaction has an equivalent information path

candidate_text: Reviews distinguish factual defects that affect correctness from optional style suggestions that a contributor may accept or decline.
draft_notes: Reusable review categories separate defects from style advice

candidate_text: Measurements are recorded with both their units and the reference frame needed to interpret direction, position, or scale.
draft_notes: Measurement convention preserves units and reference frames

candidate_text: Bluefin Monitor alerts describe the user-visible impact alongside the state of the component that triggered them.

candidate_text: During Sable Registry migrations, each staged move retains a verified return path to the pre-move data state until that stage is accepted.
draft_notes: Staged migration contract preserves a verified return path

draft_notes: Named-system contract fixes cross-region time interpretation

candidate_text: Linden Catalog keeps one canonical content record while localized wording remains a presentation layer derived from that record.
draft_notes: Localization contract separates canonical content from presentation
